jyutping: hou2 m4 jung4 ji6 sin1 V

english.note: Use this pattern when the action takes effort, including finally managing to do something or say something despite difficulty.

examples.english: I manage to say this sentence only with great difficulty.
examples.traditional: 我好唔容易先講得出呢句說話。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 m4 jung4 ji6 sin1 gong2 dak1 ceot1 ni1 geoi3 syut3 waa6
